email.subject1: a signal play for Mechanical Orchard
email.body1:
Mike, saw Imogen landed on Carahsoft's GSA Schedule, opening up federal and public-sector buyers for Mechanical Orchard.

A new high-value segment usually means more agencies in market than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Mechanical Orchard off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mike, quick follow-up for Mechanical Orchard.

Opening the public sector usually means strategic pipeline targets climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your strategic team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mike, last bit of proof for Mechanical Orchard.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Mechanical Orchard's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise AI-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mike, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling strategic pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up a public-sector motion is plenty on its own.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise and public-sector motion? I'll tailor it to Mechanical Orchard either way.
